{{Infobox auto}}
'''Hematite''' is the renamed iron ore.

The deepslate variant is '''deepslate hematite'''.

== Obtaining ==
=== Natural generation ===
As vanilla iron ore.

=== Breaking ===
Mined with a pickaxe (see [[Tools#Mining levels]]), it drops 1 raw iron (vanilla table; 2 from deepslate hematite, where adamant tools drop ingots). Silk Touch drops the block.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/iron_ore.json}}</ref>
